text.EN: One less of us, {subject}. Damn.
text.TL: Nabawasan na naman tayo, {subject}. Nakakainis.

text.EN: You stood with {faction}, {subject}. We won't forget.
text.TL: Kasama ka ng {faction}, {subject}. Hindi ka namin kalilimutan.

text.EN: We fought side by side, {subject}. Rest easy.
text.TL: Magkatabi tayong lumaban, {subject}. Pahinga ka na.

text.EN: {subject} held the line. We'll carry on.
text.TL: Hindi ka umatras, {subject}. Itutuloy namin ito.

text.EN: I hope {faction} remembers what you gave.
text.TL: Sana maalala ng {faction} ang lahat ng ibinigay mo.

text.EN: We were supposed to get through this together, {subject}.
text.TL: Dapat sabay nating nalagpasan ito, {subject}.

text.EN: You always had my back, {subject}. I should've had yours.
text.TL: Lagi mo akong ipinagtatanggol, {subject}. Dapat ginawa ko rin iyon para sa'yo.

text.EN: I won't let them forget you, {subject}.
text.TL: Hindi kita hahayaang makalimutan nila, {subject}.

text.EN: Rest now, {subject}. You did enough.
text.TL: Magpahinga ka na, {subject}. Sapat na ang ginawa mo.

text.EN: We still owed each other a drink, {subject}.
text.TL: May utang pa tayong inumin sa isa't isa, {subject}.

text.EN: So this is how it ends for you, {subject}.
text.TL: Dito pala magtatapos para sa'yo, {subject}.

text.EN: You made plenty of enemies, {subject}. I was one.
text.TL: Marami kang naging kaaway, {subject}. Isa ako roon.

text.EN: I won't mourn you, {subject}, but I won't forget this.
text.TL: Hindi kita ipagluluksa, {subject}, pero hindi ko ito malilimutan.

text.EN: The threat is gone. Keep moving.
text.TL: Wala na ang banta. Tuloy lang.

text.EN: Maybe you finally found some peace, {subject}.
text.TL: Baka nakahanap ka na rin ng katahimikan, {subject}.

text.EN: I didn't know you, {subject}. You deserved better.
text.TL: Hindi kita nakilala, {subject}. Hindi mo dapat naranasan ito.

text.EN: I hope someone remembers your name, {subject}.
text.TL: Sana may makaalala pa sa pangalan mo, {subject}.

text.EN: This place takes everyone, doesn't it?
text.TL: Nilalamon ng lugar na ito ang lahat, ano?

text.EN: Someone should have found you sooner, {subject}.
text.TL: Sana may nakakita sa'yo nang mas maaga, {subject}.

text.EN: Rest now, {subject}. I won't leave you unnamed.
text.TL: Magpahinga ka, {subject}. Hindi kita hahayaang mabaon nang walang pangalan.

text.EN: No, {subject}. You were family.
text.TL: Hindi... si {subject}. Pamilya tayo.

text.EN: I thought we'd meet again, {subject}.
text.TL: Akala ko magkikita pa tayo, {subject}.

text.EN: You should have made it home, {subject}.
text.TL: Dapat nakauwi ka pa, {subject}.

text.EN: I'll carry you with me, {subject}. I promise.
text.TL: Dadalahin kita sa alaala ko, {subject}. Pangako.

text.EN: {subject}, I'm sorry I wasn't there.
text.TL: {subject}, patawad at wala ako roon.

text.EN: Damn {killer}. {subject} stood with {faction}; we will answer for this.
text.TL: Putang ina, {killer}. Kasama ni {subject} ang {faction}; gaganti kami.

text.EN: One of ours is down, {subject}. {killer} made enemies of all of us.
text.TL: Nawalan kami ng kasama, {subject}. Ginawang kaaway ni {killer} ang lahat sa amin.

text.EN: We saw {killer} take {subject}. This is not finished.
text.TL: Nakita naming pinatay ni {killer} si {subject}. Hindi pa tapos ito.

text.EN: {killer} killed a member of {faction}. We will remember.
text.TL: Pinatay ni {killer} ang kasapi ng {faction}. Tatandaan namin ito.

text.EN: Run while you can, {killer}. We will not forget what happened to {subject}.
text.TL: Tumakbo ka habang may oras pa, {killer}. Hindi namin kalilimutan ang nangyari kay {subject}.

text.EN: Hell, {subject}. {killer} will pay for making us weaker.
text.TL: Lintik, {subject}. Magbabayad si {killer} dahil pinahina niya kami.

text.EN: {faction} lost one today. {killer} started something they cannot finish.
text.TL: May nawala sa {faction} ngayon. Sinimulan ito ni {killer} at hindi niya matatapos.

text.EN: We do not forget our own, {subject}. {killer} will answer for this.
text.TL: Hindi namin kinakalimutan ang mga kasama namin, {subject}. Mananagot si {killer}.

text.EN: Damn {killer}. {subject} was my friend, and this will cost you.
text.TL: Bwisit ka, {killer}. Kaibigan ko si {subject}; pagbabayaran mo ito.

text.EN: I saw {subject} fall. {killer} will answer for it.
text.TL: Nakita kong bumagsak si {subject}. Mananagot si {killer}.

text.EN: Hell, {subject}. What {killer} did will not be forgotten.
text.TL: Lintik, {subject}. Hindi malilimutan ang ginawa ni {killer}.

text.EN: I will not let {subject} be forgotten, and {killer} will not get away with it.
text.TL: Hindi ko hahayaang makalimutan si {subject}, at hindi makakatakas si {killer}.

text.EN: {subject} always had my back. Today, I am coming for {killer}.
text.TL: Lagi akong ipinagtatanggol ni {subject}. Ngayon, ako naman ang hahabol kay {killer}.

text.EN: Damn {killer}. {subject} mattered to us.
text.TL: Putang ina, {killer}. Mahalaga sa amin si {subject}.

text.EN: I hope {killer} knows what they took from us when they killed {subject}.
text.TL: Sana alam ni {killer} ang inagaw niya sa amin nang pinatay niya si {subject}.

text.EN: No more warnings. {killer} killed one of ours, {subject}.
text.TL: Wala nang babala. Pinatay ni {killer} ang isa sa amin, si {subject}.

text.EN: Damn it, {killer}. You took {subject} from their family. This will not go unanswered.
text.TL: Putang ina, {killer}. Inagaw mo si {subject} sa pamilya niya. Hindi ito palalampasin.

text.EN: I saw {subject} fall. {killer} will answer for this, I swear it.
text.TL: Nakita kong bumagsak si {subject}. Mananagot si {killer} sa ginawa niya, isinusumpa ko.

text.EN: What {killer} did to {subject} will never be forgiven.
text.TL: Hindi ko mapapatawad ang ginawa ni {killer} kay {subject}.

text.EN: Hell, {subject}. {killer} is going to pay for this.
text.TL: Lintik, {subject}. Magbabayad si {killer} sa ginawa niya.

text.EN: I will not let {subject}'s death go unanswered. {killer} started this.
text.TL: Hindi ko hahayaang walang hustisya ang pagkamatay ni {subject}. Sinimulan ito ni {killer}.

text.EN: No. Not {subject}. {killer} just made this personal.
text.TL: Hindi. Hindi si {subject}. Ginawa itong personal ni {killer}.

text.EN: {subject} was family. {killer} will regret this.
text.TL: Pamilya si {subject}. Pagsisisihan ito ni {killer}.

text.EN: Rest now, {subject}. I hope {killer} runs, because I am coming.
text.TL: Magpahinga ka muna, {subject}. Sana tumakbo si {killer}, dahil hahabulin ko siya.

text.EN: I heard {subject} did not make it back.
text.TL: Balita ko, hindi na nakabalik si {subject}.

text.EN: They say {subject} stayed behind so others could escape.
text.TL: Sabi nila, nagpaiwan si {subject} para makatakas ang iba.

text.EN: Someone says {subject} cannot keep track of their own gear.
text.TL: Sabi nila, hindi maalagaan ni {subject} ang sarili niyang gamit.

text.EN: {subject} talked big, then backed down when it mattered.
text.TL: Malakas ang loob magsalita ni {subject}, pero umurong nang kailangan nang kumilos.

text.EN: Watch {subject}; their story keeps changing.
text.TL: Bantayan si {subject}; pabago-bago ang kuwento niya.

text.EN: {subject} left someone behind when the zombies closed in.
text.TL: Iniwan ni {subject} ang kasama niya nang sumalakay ang mga zombie.

text.EN: People have spotted danger near {place}.
text.TL: May nakapansing panganib malapit sa {place}.

text.EN: I got away when a whole horde came after me.
text.TL: Nakatakas ako nang habulin ako ng napakaraming zombie.

text.EN: Word is {subject} was seen near {place}.
text.TL: May nakakita raw kay {subject} malapit sa {place}.

text.EN: {subject} has been looking out for people.
text.TL: Inaalalayan ni {subject} ang mga tao.

text.EN: {subject} stood up for someone when an attacker closed in.
text.TL: Ipinagtanggol ni {subject} ang isang tao nang may umatake.

text.EN: {subject} got someone home alive.
text.TL: Naiuwi ni {subject} nang buhay ang isang tao.

text.EN: I heard what happened to {subject}. I hope they are holding up.
text.TL: Narinig ko ang nangyari kay {subject}. Sana kinakaya niya.
